scope: Official RTK14 name-list baseline. No fixed upper cap; additional verified series entries may be appended. This is a production roster, not 1000 playable characters.
policy: Names only from publisher reference. Artwork is newly generated for this project. Homonyms remain distinct; alternate portraits never increase character counts. Romance/history classification and remaining Korean names need per-character review. Ancient and crossover bonuses are outside the Three Kingdoms baseline.
